title: David Becomes Saul's Harpist
description: After the Spirit of the Lord had departed from Saul, he was troubled by an evil spirit from the Lord. His servants suggested finding a harpist who could soothe him, and one of them recommended David, the son of Jesse from Bethlehem. Saul sent for David, who came with gifts from his father. David became Saul's armor-bearer, and whenever the evil spirit came upon Saul, David played the harp to ease the king [ref:1 Sam 16:14-23|1 Samuel 16:14-23].
